_comment: The maker flow: what the boss can start in three taps, the passes each kind of job goes through, and the bars its Tester and the review loop hold it to. server/makers.js reads this file. No money anywhere in it.

passes._comment: depth: depth passes after the playable slice (0 to max). A job runs at least minDepthPasses (per type) even when every done-rule already passes. An open major or blocker bug holds Launch and sends the team straight into a fix pass; after fixesBeforeAsking failed fix attempts the boss chooses: keep trying, or launch anyway with a warning. A pass that fails with no serious bug asks after failsBeforeAsking tries. maxJobTokens stops a job at a count of model tokens: 0 means no such limit, because a job ends when it is good, and the one money limit is the per-task safety net.

game.label: Game
game.blurb: A real game with levels, enemies and upgrades
passJobs: More mechanics and content: new enemies or obstacles, new abilities, new things to do. Something a player notices in the first minute of a run.
Progression and meta: unlocks and upgrades that matter, a difficulty curve that really ramps, more levels or waves, a reason to play one more run.

Balance, onboarding, juice and audio: tune the numbers so the first minute teaches and the last minute tests, clear first-run hints, shake, particles, tweens, hit-stop, sound for every action, and a mute that works.
game.goal: A game people play for 10+ minutes, with saves and a shared leaderboard, live at a link
plan: Design doc: core loop, controls, 3+ mechanics, levels, upgrades, juice
Depth passes, each one played by the Tester in a real browser

doneRules.text: Loads with 0 console errors
Keyboard, touch and gamepad input change the game state
No soft-lock over 60 s of scripted plus random input, and restart always works
Frame rate stays playable
Menu, play, pause, game over and settings are all reachable
Progress saves and scores post to the leaderboard through Office Cloud
At least 3 distinct mechanics or enemy types, as the design doc says
Levels or waves that ramp, upgrades or unlocks, scoring and a win or lose
Juice and audio: shake, particles, tweens, hit-stop and sound, with mute
Plays on a phone with on-screen or tap controls
Enough content for 10+ minutes of play
The late game holds up: the final boss or last level and the win screen work, checked every pass on a debug copy
No cheat or debug hook in the shipped build: no ?wave= style links, god mode, test keys or debug panels

app.label: App / SaaS
app.blurb: A signed-in web app with real accounts and data
app.goal: A working web app: sign up, make something, find it again tomorrow, live at a link
plan: Spec: who it is for, the core object, the screens
Landing page plus a signed-in app shell on the starter
Polish passes, each tested end to end by the Tester

doneRules.text: Landing and app load with 0 console errors
Sign up works and lands in the app
Creating something shows it at once
After a reload it is still there
Sign out and back in, and it is still there
Fits a 390 px phone with nothing scrolling sideways
Empty, loading and error states are real, not blank
Edit and delete work as well as create
A settings screen that does something
Payments only as a clearly marked coming-soon hook, nothing invented

website.label: Website
website.blurb: A fast, good-looking site with real words
website.goal: A fast site that looks made for this subject, with a contact form that works, live at a link
plan: Words and look: who it is for, the one thing a visitor should do
Polish passes, each checked by the Tester at phone and desktop size

doneRules.text: Loads with 0 console errors
Fits a 390 px phone with nothing scrolling sideways
No broken links or missing sections
Title, description, og tags, favicon and lang
The contact form really submits and thanks the visitor
Looks made for this subject, not a template
Real words only: nothing invented, no placeholder

business.label: Business
business.blurb: Research, a plan and a landing page, step by step
business.goal: A researched idea with a plan and a live landing page
plan: Researched idea cards with real links

game.title: Lighthouse Keeper
game.pitch: Keep the lamps lit through a storm night while moths, gulls and waves come for the light. Upgrade the tower between nights.
mechanics: aim the beam to scare moths
gulls that dive and must be dodged
waves that knock out lamps you relight

game.title: Scrapyard Courier
game.pitch: Race parcels across a robot junkyard. Magnet drones pull you, rust crawlers block lanes, sparkers chain. Spend salvage on boosts.

game.title: Neon Hive
game.pitch: Defend a glowing hive from wasps, hornets and a queen. Collect pollen to grow new cells that fire back.

game.title: Sky Ferry
game.pitch: Fly a little ferry between floating islands, pick up passengers and dodge storm cells. Each island day adds a new hazard.
mechanics: pick-ups and drop-offs on a timer
wind lanes that push the ferry

game.title: Glacier Post
game.pitch: A penguin postie slides down a glacier: carve lanes, grab letters, jump crevasses, outrun the avalanche.

game.title: Mole Mayor
game.pitch: Dig tunnels for your town and hold off beetles, roots and floods. Each wave unlocks a new room to build.

game.title: Pocket Planet
game.pitch: Run around a tiny planet planting trees while meteors fall. Trees shield you; the planet grows each wave.

game.title: Midnight Kitchen
game.pitch: A one-cook diner at 2am. Juggle orders, fend off raccoons and keep the grill from catching fire. Unlock new dishes nightly.

app.title: Shift Swap
app.pitch: A small team posts shifts they can't make, and teammates claim them in a tap. Everyone sees the week at a glance.

app.title: Streak Jar
app.pitch: Track a few habits with a jar that fills as you keep streaks. Notes per day, a weekly look back.

app.title: Setlist
app.pitch: Bands build setlists from their song bank, drag to reorder, and share a read-only link with the venue.

app.title: Pantry Pal
app.pitch: Log what's in the cupboard and when it runs out. See what to use first and what to buy next.

app.title: Client Notes
app.pitch: A tiny CRM for freelancers: clients, the last time you spoke, and what you promised.

app.title: Feedback Wall
app.pitch: Collect feature requests from your users, let them vote, and mark what shipped.

app.title: Tool Library
app.pitch: Neighbours list tools they'll lend, borrow with a tap, and see who has the ladder.

website.title: Studio Portfolio
website.pitch: A portfolio that feels like walking into the studio: the work big, the story short, a way to get in touch.

website.title: Corner Bakery
website.pitch: A neighbourhood bakery's site: what's on the counter, when it opens, and a pre-order form.

website.title: Band Site
website.pitch: A band's home on the web: the next gigs, the songs, and a booking form for venues.

website.title: Bike Repair Stand
website.pitch: A pop-up repair stand: what it fixes, where it parks this week, and a form to book a slot.

website.title: Dog Walker
website.pitch: A local dog walker's site that says the area, the routine and how to book a meet-and-greet.

website.title: Event Page
website.pitch: One event, done properly: the when and where, the programme, and an RSVP form.

business.title: Meal prep for shift workers
business.pitch: Find out if night-shift nurses would pay for meals that fit their hours, then plan it and put up a landing page.

business.title: Dog grooming at home
business.pitch: Research home grooming visits in your area: who charges what, who would book, and what to offer first.

business.title: Exam tutoring pods
business.pitch: Small-group tutoring before exams. Research prices and demand, then plan the offer and the page.

business.title: Phone repair pickups
business.pitch: Pick up broken phones from offices and return them fixed the same day. Check the market first.

business.title: Office plant care
business.pitch: Weekly plant care for small offices. Who does it now, what they charge, and what would win the first ten clients.
